items.title: Willie Hightower Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: Armand J.P. Rons had a band before I went there... naturally they put me in the band and commenced to giving me charge right away and teaching me... There was Armand J.P. Rons on violin

ctx.x: Eddie Grossell's Casino. Eddie Grossell's Casino. Eddie Grossell's Casino.

Eddie Grossell's Casino. Yeah. You can put that down if you want. And he had, his partner was Del Peter, and his manager was a German Jew, Mr. Hunts. Hunts was his name. And everything was run through transportation of the theaters and all the Spokin people that came in town to shows. Like every show would come to the Crescent Theater or Tulane, don't care if it was, those two theaters sat right together, the Crescent and Tulane, the Opera House, and don't care what sort of show it was, they'd go get those people…
